title: Beachhead (four converging threads)
source: Blueprint worked example (Nolan-style interleaved timeline), Section 4, expanded to four threads
cf_source: Perturbed twin of story_01_beachhead -- same gold graph, renamed characters

threads.label: Winters, a home-front radio operator, tracking the evacuation by wireless
threads.cf_label: Okafor, a home-front radio operator, tracking the evacuation by wireless

events.time_expr: barely a minute into the dogfight
events.cf_time_expr: barely a minute into the dogfight
events.text: Farrow scans the horizon from the cockpit, fuel gauge dropping fast.
events.cf_text: Reyes scans the horizon from the cockpit, fuel gauge dropping fast.

events.text: Tanner has been dug into the sand for six days, waiting for a ship that never comes.
events.cf_text: Corriell has been dug into the sand for six days, waiting for a ship that never comes.

events.text: Dawson pushes his fishing boat out from the coast at first light, three hours from the beach.
events.cf_text: Halvorsen pushes his fishing boat out from the coast at first light, three hours from the beach.

events.text: He banks hard as a plane goes down below him, the fight barely a minute old.
events.cf_text: He banks hard as a plane goes down below him, the fight barely a minute old.

events.text: He watches the mole get bombed for the third time that week.
events.cf_text: He watches the mole get bombed for the third time that week.

events.text: He pulls a shivering pilot from the water, radio crackling with news from the beach.
events.cf_text: He pulls a shivering pilot from the water, radio crackling with news from the beach.

events.text: Gliding now with the engine cut, he sees hundreds of men lined up on the sand below.
events.cf_text: Gliding now with the engine cut, he sees hundreds of men lined up on the sand below.

events.time_expr: one week after reaching the beach
events.cf_time_expr: one week after reaching the beach
events.text: Tanner finally boards a ship, one week after he first reached the beach.
events.cf_text: Corriell finally boards a ship, one week after he first reached the beach.

events.text: Dawson's boat reaches the mole just as Tanner's ship is pulling away.
events.cf_text: Halvorsen's boat reaches the mole just as Corriell's ship is pulling away.

events.time_expr: before dawn, the morning of the dogfight
events.cf_time_expr: before dawn, the morning of the dogfight
events.text: Farrow climbs into the cockpit before dawn, briefed on the thousands massed along a beach across the water.
events.cf_text: Reyes climbs into the cockpit before dawn, briefed on the thousands massed along a beach across the water.

events.time_expr: over the channel, minutes before contact
events.cf_time_expr: over the channel, minutes before contact
events.text: He crosses the channel at altitude, smoke already rising from the coastline ahead.
events.cf_text: He crosses the channel at altitude, smoke already rising from the coastline ahead.

events.text: Farrow lines up a burst on an enemy fighter, tracer fire stitching the sky as another plane spins away trailing smoke.
events.cf_text: Reyes lines up a burst on an enemy fighter, tracer fire stitching the sky as another plane spins away trailing smoke.

events.text: He watches the coastline rise fast, the crowded sand now filling the whole of his windscreen.
events.cf_text: He watches the coastline rise fast, the crowded sand now filling the whole of his windscreen.

events.text: The pilot braces in the cockpit as the sea rushes up grey and flat beneath him.
events.cf_text: The pilot braces in the cockpit as the sea rushes up grey and flat beneath him.

events.text: Farrow ditches just short of the sand, scrambling clear of the cockpit as the plane noses under.
events.cf_text: Reyes ditches just short of the sand, scrambling clear of the cockpit as the plane noses under.

events.text: He is hauled, dripping, over the gunwale of a small fishing boat, the whole ordeal over almost as soon as it began.
events.cf_text: He is hauled, dripping, over the gunwale of a small fishing boat, the whole ordeal over almost as soon as it began.

events.text: He queues at the water's edge for hours, watching ship after ship turn back under strafing fire.
events.cf_text: He queues at the water's edge for hours, watching ship after ship turn back under strafing fire.

events.text: He shares a tin of rations with a stranger, both of them trading rumors of a mole further down the beach.
events.cf_text: He shares a tin of rations with a stranger, both of them trading rumors of a mole further down the beach.

events.text: Tanner helps drive stranded trucks out into the shallows, building a makeshift jetty at low tide.
events.cf_text: Corriell helps drive stranded trucks out into the shallows, building a makeshift jetty at low tide.

events.text: He watches a destroyer go down just offshore, the tide afterward pushing wreckage back onto the sand.
events.cf_text: He watches a destroyer go down just offshore, the tide afterward pushing wreckage back onto the sand.

events.text: Tanner is herded into an orderly line along the mole for the first time all week.
events.cf_text: Corriell is herded into an orderly line along the mole for the first time all week.

events.text: He is given a place near the front of the queue as darkness falls.
events.cf_text: He is given a place near the front of the queue as darkness falls.

events.text: Word passes down the line the instant dawn breaks: ships have been spotted approaching the mole.
events.cf_text: Word passes down the line the instant dawn breaks: ships have been spotted approaching the mole.

events.text: He steers around a drifting lifeboat, empty and half-swamped in the swell.
events.cf_text: He steers around a drifting lifeboat, empty and half-swamped in the swell.

events.text: He spots the wreckage of a downed fighter bobbing in the water ahead.
events.cf_text: He spots the wreckage of a downed fighter bobbing in the water ahead.

events.text: Dawson changes course toward a lone figure waving from the waves.
events.cf_text: Halvorsen changes course toward a lone figure waving from the waves.

events.text: The rescued pilot, wrapped in a blanket, points Dawson toward the mole where the crowds are thickest.
events.cf_text: The rescued pilot, wrapped in a blanket, points Halvorsen toward the mole where the crowds are thickest.

events.text: His boat joins a line of small craft ferrying men out to the larger ships, the work stretching on into the early afternoon.
events.cf_text: His boat joins a line of small craft ferrying men out to the larger ships, the work stretching on into the early afternoon.

events.text: He takes on a dozen soldiers, the little boat riding low and the fuel gauge sinking toward empty.
events.cf_text: He takes on a dozen soldiers, the little boat riding low and the fuel gauge sinking toward empty.

events.text: Dawson turns back toward the mole for one more run before the fuel runs out.
events.cf_text: Halvorsen turns back toward the mole for one more run before the fuel runs out.

events.text: Winters logs the first garbled signal at the listening post: large numbers stranded, awaiting evacuation.
events.cf_text: Okafor logs the first garbled signal at the listening post: large numbers stranded, awaiting evacuation.

events.text: A bulletin crackles through describing repeated bombing runs on a mole somewhere near the beach.
events.cf_text: A bulletin crackles through describing repeated bombing runs on a mole somewhere near the beach.

events.text: Winters relays an urgent request for every available small craft to the Admiralty.
events.cf_text: Okafor relays an urgent request for every available small craft to the Admiralty.

events.text: He hears of a destroyer lost just offshore and holds off telling the families waiting outside.
events.cf_text: He hears of a destroyer lost just offshore and holds off telling the families waiting outside.

events.time_expr: day 7, the instant the dogfight opens
events.cf_time_expr: day 7, the instant the dogfight opens
events.text: A burst of Morse reports fighters clashing in the skies above the beach, the signal almost drowned out by static.
events.cf_text: A burst of Morse reports fighters clashing in the skies above the beach, the signal almost drowned out by static.

events.time_expr: day 7, late morning into early afternoon
events.cf_time_expr: day 7, late morning into early afternoon
events.text: Word comes over the wireless that civilian boats are ferrying soldiers from the beach in growing numbers.
events.cf_text: Word comes over the wireless that civilian boats are ferrying soldiers from the beach in growing numbers.

events.text: Winters hears, secondhand, that a downed pilot was fished alive out of the Channel.
events.cf_text: Okafor hears, secondhand, that a downed pilot was fished alive out of the Channel.

events.text: A report notes that the queues on the mole are finally moving quickly.
events.cf_text: A report notes that the queues on the mole are finally moving quickly.

events.text: Word arrives that the last ships have pulled away from the mole.
events.cf_text: Word arrives that the last ships have pulled away from the mole.

events.text: Winters logs the final tally of the day and switches off the set, the beach reportedly emptying at last.
events.cf_text: Okafor logs the final tally of the day and switches off the set, the beach reportedly emptying at last.
